name: Fukashi na Aijou ~Toumei na Boku ni Kanjiru Mama~
original_name: 不可視な愛情～透明なボクに感じるママ～
source: Shinya picks up a mysterious medicine that can make him literally invisible. Now its time to fulfill all the sexual desires he is holding towards his own mother.
translation: 慎也捡到一种神秘药物，能让他的身体真正变得透明。现在，他终于可以满足自己一直压抑的、对亲生母亲美弥子的所有性欲。
